author: /root/recover_delivery
brief: Show a large loose sheet and partly unrolled roll of decorative paper beside one partly wrapped present, with the paper as the main subject. Use a cheerful repeating motif without text. Reject a completed gift box alone, a wrapping action close-up, a ribbon-only picture, or patterned cloth.

records.title: Coloured gift paper
records.creator: Asta (Flickr display name written as Åsta on the source page)
records.license_evidence: Commons identifies the original Flickr creator and CC BY 2.0. A named reviewer confirmed that grant on 2006-11-13; the page records that a later Flickr licensing change does not revoke it.
records.attribution: Coloured gift paper by Åsta, via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0. Source inspection thumbnails resized only; original JPEG unchanged.
records.visual_inspection: A fan of overlapping patterned sheets fills the frame. The patterns and lower sheet edges are clear at source size; there is no roll or present. At source-derived 72px and 44px card sizes it becomes a small pattern fan rather than the approved paper/roll/present composition.
records.decision: Rejected as a complete word image. Retain only as a licensed reference for real paper sheets; no crop or added placeholder geometry is proposed.

records.title: Gift wrapping in a jewellery shop 5
records.creator: W.carter / Ann-Sophie Qvarnström
records.license_evidence: The author publishes own work under CC BY-SA 4.0 on the Commons source page. Attribution and same-license or compatible-license terms apply to adaptations; the source and license must remain linked.
records.attribution: Gift wrapping in a jewellery shop 5 by W.carter (Ann-Sophie Qvarnström), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Source inspection thumbnails resized only; original JPEG unchanged.
records.visual_inspection: Two completely wrapped silver packages with large dark-pink ribbon bows dominate a white background. No decorative loose sheet, roll or incomplete wrapping appears. The bows dominate at both small card sizes.
records.decision: Rejected as a complete word image because it depicts finished gifts and ribbon.

records.title: Elegant Christmas Gift Wrapping Scene
records.creator: Lydia Griva (Pexels handle iris)
records.license_evidence: The exact primary listing marks the photograph free. The official license allows free use in an app and modification; attribution is optional. It excludes unaltered-copy sales, stock/wallpaper redistribution, implied endorsement and trademark use.
records.attribution: Photograph by Lydia Griva on Pexels. Source inspection thumbnails resized only; original-format JPEG unchanged.
records.visual_inspection: A large completed striped parcel occupies the foreground beside a smaller completed deer-patterned parcel. Many rolls, cards, an envelope, stickers, string and ribbon compete around them. Several visible items carry text; no large loose sheet and partly wrapped present are established. At 72px and 44px card sizes the narrow scene is cluttered and its paper geometry is indistinct.
records.decision: Rejected as a complete word image. The original is preserved for evidence; missing subject matter is not supplied by a crop.

records.title: Wraping Paper
records.creator: j4p4n; publisher describes a remix of paper-roll-vector-clip-art
records.license: CC0 1.0 Universal, as linked by FreeSVG
records.license_evidence: The primary listing identifies Public Domain and its sitewide notice links CC0. The page names j4p4n as publisher and identifies the parent roll illustration. No exact original SVG was acquired.
records.attribution: Wraping Paper by j4p4n, FreeSVG, CC0. Acquired source-preview PNG only; full-fit review thumbnails resized from that preview.
records.animation_evidence: Inspected static PNG preview only; original SVG not acquired, so original animation/layer content is unverified.
records.visual_inspection: The visible illustration is a pink roll with green dots and a short unrolled tail, with simple shaded curvature and no text. It has no separate large loose sheet and no present. At small source-derived card sizes the horizontal roll is tiny within its square transparent canvas.
records.decision: Possible roll illustration reference only, rejected as a complete image. Public original SVG link returned HTTP 200 with an empty text/html body; response retained, not counted as an acquired SVG and not retried. The large PNG link redirected to the site homepage. No synthetic completion or integration is proposed.

search_scope: Fresh public web searches across Pexels, Commons, public-domain/vector sources and general licensed-image leads. Returned repeats were not reacquired. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no suitable image exists anywhere.

visual_qa.basis: Raw word_card.gd setup uses 72x72, picture offsets 12/10/-12/-10 and aspect-centered fitting. memory_garden.gd overrides a card minimum to 44x44 and uses adaptive layout. The sheet reproduces those nominal boxes only; actual rendered card dimensions remain device/layout dependent.
visual_qa.adaptation: Whole images fitted without cropping, sharpening, recoloring, added content or placeholder artwork; simple labeled inspection panels are review UI only.
visual_qa.conclusion: Every inspected asset fails the complete composition at source size, and the nominal game-size inspection does not repair it.

remaining_dependency: Acquire a complete licensed image that visibly makes the decorative paper dominant while showing a large loose sheet, a partly unrolled roll and one partly wrapped present, with a cheerful repeating motif and no text. Existing textures and the new roll preview are components/references only. No source geometry assembly, model rendering, generated replacement, shared media edit or runtime acceptance is authorized by this record.
